edges.fact: USER dropped the idea of a side trip to the Faroe Islands due to logistical challenges and expensive inter-island flights.
USER is considering adding a day or two in the Westfjords to their Iceland trip due to Dana's recommendation and the desire for actual quiet.
USER is considering reducing time spent on the Golden Circle tour, as Dana described it as overrated and too touristy.
USER is considering the chances of seeing the Northern Lights in Iceland in late May, inspired by a coworker's experience in Tromsø.
USER mentioned that their partner's coworker Raj recently returned from Tromsø and reported decent Northern Lights chances in late May.
USER prefers Svarta Kaffið in Reykjavik for its simple, honest food, particularly the lamb soup served in a hollowed-out bread bowl.
USER trusts Dana's judgment on travel matters, as Dana has been to 30 countries.
User booked accommodation at Black Beach Guesthouse near Vik, which has six rooms.
User booked flights through Icelandair in early March.
User changed the return flight date to May 26th with Icelandair.
User is planning to visit Seljavallalaug, a hidden hot spring tucked into a valley.
User is planning to visit the Snæfellsnes Peninsula for an extra day.
User prefers to eat plokkfiskur, a type of traditional Icelandic mashed fish stew.
